subject: Residency + HSM seat bundle — pricing and pilot commitments
messages:
From: Megan Taylor <megan.taylor@healthplex.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Glen Park <glen.procure@vendorflow.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Initial scope: residency + HSM seats + audit log retention

Hi Karthik,

Appreciate the time on the call this morning. A quick recap and what procurement needs to move forward:

- HealthPlex is evaluating a pilot (6 months) with a goal to go into full production in Q2 next year.
- Must have: US data residency (east region), HSM-backed key management for PHI, and audit log retention options we can scale.
- Procurement wants a single line-item price for the HSM seats (initial 3 seats), an annual recurring charge for auditlog tiering (30/90/365 days), and an implementation SOW that can be amortized or taken as a one-time fee.

Can you send a clear pricing sheet and indicate what discounts are available with a 12-month committed consumption and a pilot-to-production conversion credit? Also, we need SOC2 evidence and an estimated timeline for HSM provisioning.

Thanks — we need a proposal to review with Legal this week.

Megan
Senior Procurement Manager
HealthPlex
[Attachment: Requirements-HealthPlex-20261117.pdf (pdf, referenced)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Taylor <megan.taylor@healthplex.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-17T11:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial scope: residency + HSM seats + audit log retention

Hi Megan — thanks for the clear summary. Attached is a focused price sheet and a preliminary SOW for the pilot. High-level answers inline: 

- HSM seats: list price $9,500/seat/month. With a 12-month committed consumption on Dedicated (min commit $85k/mo) we can offer a 25% seat discount for the first year (pilot converted into production). That brings the seat price to $7,125/seat/month for year one if you commit.

- Audit log retention: modular tiers priced per GB/month and a small per-account feature surcharge. See the attached AuditLog-pricing.xlsx for the three tiers we discussed (30/90/365). We can apply a pilot credit: first 3 months of audit logs free (up to 500GB) if pilot converts within 90 days.

- Implementation SOW: Standard one-time setup $45k, or we can amortize $15k/year as a recurring service add-on if you prefer Opex.

- SOC2 + evidence: I’ve attached our SOC2 summary and can provide SOC2 report (redacted) under NDA. HSM provisioning (once order accepted + KYC) typically 3–4 weeks.

Attachments: AuditLog-pricing.xlsx (xlsx), SOW-draft.pdf (pdf), SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf)

Next steps: If acceptable, Dev can draft a DocuSign-ready order form and we’ll show the pricing lines broken down for PO entry. If procurement prefers seat-based vs throughput billing for HSM-backed key operations we can model both.

Cheers,
Karthik
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T08:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial scope: residency + HSM seats + audit log retention

Karthik / Dev — a couple of commercial notes before we send final numbers to HealthPlex: 

1) Audit log tiering: recommend we present two models — (A) per-GB retention tiers with a committed baseline (better for predictable spend), and (B) unlimited retention at a flat surcharge for enterprise accounts for simplicity. Offer (B) as an up-sell with a lower commit requirement.

2) HSM seat amortization vs seat license: for healthcare accounts we usually do a 3-seat minimum and offer a staggered discount: 25% at 12 months commit, 35% at 24 months. But for this deal — because they’re a pilot customer — suggest keeping 25% + one-time pilot-conversion credit of $30k that reduces implementation SOW if conversion happens.

3) Be explicit about export/import key support and KMS integration window — Legal asks this. Add a line: 'HSM key import/export supported under documented KMS playbook; 2-week lead engineering alignment after order.'

I’ve updated the excel with alternate tier (sheet "Alt-Flat").

—V
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GTM Pricing

From: Megan Taylor <megan.taylor@healthplex.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Glen Park <glen.procure@vendorflow.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T10:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial scope: residency + HSM seats + audit log retention

Karthik — thanks, that was fast. A few follow-ups from Legal/Procurement after a first pass: 

- Procurement will accept the 12-month seat discount but asks for an explicit clause: if pilot extends beyond 90 days without conversion, the discount resets to 15% for the remaining period.
- Can you confirm the SOW credit ($30k) is applied at the time of conversion and is non-refundable if conversion is delayed? Procurement needs that in writing.
- We prefer the per-GB committed baseline (option A) but would like a clear migration path to the flat-surplus model (B) at renewal.

Final ask: Can you provide a dotted-line order form (DocuSign) that separates HSM seat lines, audit-log tier lines, and the one-time SOW so our PO can map to three GL codes? Glen (cc) will coordinate the PO entry.

Megan

Date: 2026-11-24T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Residency + HSM seats + audit log retention — pricing and pilot commitments

Hi Megan / Karthik / Vanessa,

Thanks — I prepared a DocuSign-ready order that separates the three GL lines (HSM seats, AuditLog retention, Implementation SOW) and included the conversion credit language we discussed. Key commercial points captured: 

- 25% discount applied at order if 12-month committed consumption signed; if pilot extends >90 days without conversion, discount steps down to 15% for remainder of contracted year.
- $30,000 SOW credit applied on execution of the production conversion signature; credit is not refundable and is only applied against the remaining implementation balance.
- AuditLog committed baseline is billable monthly; migration to flat enterprise surcharge documented as a renewal amendment.

Attachments: DocuSign-Order-8573.pdf (pdf)
DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/sign/8573 (order form pre-filled)

If HealthPlex confirms, Glen can issue a PO referencing three GL codes and we’ll start HSM provisioning (3–4 week lead).

One small operational note: we’ll need a KMS contact from HealthPlex to exchange keying details and an account owner for onboarding tasks.

—Dev
Sales Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
